title: Politics Beyond the Ballot: Digital Media and Democratic Participation in India
description: There was a time when political participation in India was relatively easy to identify. Citizens voted in elections, attended rallies, joined party organisations, wrote letters to newspaper editors, or participated in protests. Politics occupied a visible space in public life.
